title: Hong Kong Data Center Loan Sale Shows Banks Hitting Sector Limits
title_zh: 香港数据中心贷款销售显示银行触及行业限制
summary: (Bloomberg) -- An attempt by a lender to offload a portion of a loan backing a Hong Kong data center project is highlighting a global trend of banks reshuffling lending to keep exposure to the booming sector within limits.Most Read from BloombergChip Rout Deepens on Circular F...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——一家贷款机构试图卸下支持香港数据中心项目的部分贷款，这突显了银行重组贷款以将对蓬勃发展的行业的风险控制在一定范围内的全球趋势。彭博社的大多数报道在通函 F 上加深了芯片溃败。

title: Wall Street ends mixed as investors await tech earnings
title_zh: 投资者等待科技财报，华尔街收盘涨跌互现
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes closed mixed on Tuesday with the Dow gaining 1%, the S&P 500 edging up about two-tenths of a percent and the Nasdaq dipping by roughly two-tenths of a percent.Markets have been volatile this month as investors worry that Microsoft, Amazon and ...
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周二收盘涨跌互现，道琼斯指数上涨 1%，标准普尔 500 指数小幅上涨约十分之二，纳斯达克指数下跌约十分之二。本月市场波动较大，因为投资者担心微软、亚马逊和……

title: Markets brace for Fed decision and Big Tech earnings
title_zh: 市场为美联储决定和大型科技公司盈利做好准备
summary: Josh Lipton stock the market movers for Wednesday, July 29th, including the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision.
summary_zh: 乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 介绍了 7 月 29 日星期三的市场走势，包括美联储的利率决定。

title: US stocks mixed ahead key tech earnings, Fed
title_zh: 美联储关键科技财报公布后，美国股市涨跌互现
summary: By Karen Brettell and Sruthi Shankar July 28 (Reuters) - U.S. stocks were mixed on Tuesday ahead of key corporate earnings releases and the Federal Reserve's highly anticipated interest rate decision
summary_zh: 作者：Karen Brettell 和 Sruthi Shankar 7 月 28 日（路透社）——周二，在关键企业财报发布和美联储备受期待的利率决定之前，美国股市涨跌互现。

title: Assessing the chip sector's damage: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 评估芯片行业的损失：每日图表
summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a closer look at recent market action in the semiconductor sector (^SOX).
summary_zh: 雅虎财经市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 仔细研究了半导体行业近期的市场走势 (^SOX)。

title: Apple's market cap tops $5T: How AI weakness became a strength
title_zh: 苹果市值突破 5T 美元：AI 弱点如何变成优势
summary: Apple's (AAPL) market cap topped $5 trillion, becoming only the second company ever to do so. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley outlines the details.
summary_zh: 苹果公司 (AAPL) 的市值突破 5 万亿美元，成为第二家突破 5 万亿美元的公司。雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 概述了详细信息。

title: Mag 7 earnings: Alphabet 'really set the tone,' strategist says
title_zh: Mag 7 财报：策略师称 Alphabet“确实定下了基调”
summary: Meta Platforms (META), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN), and Apple (AAPL) are the next Big Tech names — part of the Magnificent Seven — to report quarterly earnings results this week.
summary_zh: 元平台 (META)、微软 (MSFT)、亚马逊 (AMZN) 和苹果 (AAPL) 是下一个在本周公布季度收益报告的科技巨头——七巨头的一部分。

title: Apple's Tim Cook on succession: John Ternus is 'ready to be a first-class CEO'
title_zh: 苹果蒂姆·库克谈继任者：约翰·特努斯“已准备好成为一流首席执行官”
summary: At the premiere of season four of Ted Lasso, Apple (AAPL) CEO Tim Cook and incoming CEO John Ternus reflect on Apple's seamless executive transition, expressing mutual confidence in Ternus's upcoming leadership.
summary_zh: 在《Ted Lasso》第四季首映式上，苹果公司 (Apple) 首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 和即将上任的首席执行官约翰·特纳斯 (John Ternus) 反思了苹果公司无缝的高管过渡，表达了对特纳斯即将到来的领导层的相互信心。

title: CLARITY Act hits summer roadblock
title_zh: 清晰度法案遇到夏季障碍
summary: Scott Melker dives into the roadblocks delaying the CLARITY Act, CME’s expansion into near round-the-clock futures trading, and the surge in blockchain activity as token prices cool. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m.
summary_zh: Scott Melker 深入探讨了 CLARITY 法案延迟实施的障碍、CME 向近乎全天候期货交易的扩张，以及随着代币价格降温而导致的区块链活动激增。 《The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker》每天中午 12:00 播出。
